initial_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: polished Devpost promotional cover, exact landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Primary request: Design a sophisticated, original nocturnal cyanotype print poster for KHAYAL, a playful local Twitch shadow theater where your own body defends five lanterns while chat sends mischievous shadow characters. This is clearly promotional illustration, never a fabricated screenshot.
Style/medium: Flat cut-paper silhouettes and cyanotype photographic contact-print feeling. Beautiful restrained editorial graphic design, matte fine cyanotype grain, thin engraved near-ivory details, visually mature, memorable at thumbnail scale.
Composition: Generous negative space. Huge meticulously set sans or editorial display word KHAYAL fills the left upper quadrant with ample margins. Beneath it, a small but crisp and readable two-line or single-line tagline. No other text. On center-right, a large moonlike pale cyan circular aperture is the stage. A graceful pale human body silhouette with two arms extended in a playful defensive dance spans the aperture, protecting EXACTLY FIVE small suspended lanterns. Lanterns hang across the circular opening at varied heights, each tiny flame a warm amber accent. The human is unmistakably a real body shape simplified as paper-cut shadow, no costume or superhero armor. Expressive curling afreet spirit outlines play around the arms. A small distinct cat, a felucca sailboat silhouette, and a camel enter from the right as playful separated paper-cut characters, their crisp outlines recognizable. Maintain a clean dramatic hierarchy: title, body gesture, five lights, small mischievous characters. Every character is subordinate to the central human gesture; elegant, not crowded.
Color palette: midnight ink blue #07182E background, secondary print blue #12395C, ice-blue / near-ivory #DAF0EF silhouettes and type, restrained amber #E9B96A ONLY on the five lantern flames. No pure black or pure white. No other hues.
Text verbatim, perfectly spelled: "KHAYAL"
Text verbatim, perfectly spelled: "YOUR BODY. CHAT’S PLAYGROUND."
Typography: Huge refined uppercase editorial sans display title; small carefully spaced sans tagline; strong optically balanced kerning, calm professional poster layout. Title must be clean and dominant, not hand-scrawled.
Constraints: exact 1536x1024 canvas, flat printed illustration, clean margins, no border. Absolutely no red, tan, parchment, curtains, wood, brass, ornate borders, Mamluk ornament, city skyline, steampunk, 3D plastic toys, emoji, mock UI, Twitch or other corporate logos, camera device, gameplay HUD, neon glow, glass effects, photoreal stage, or heroic game armor. No extra text, no watermark.

CHAT’S PLAYGROUND.", body pose, afreet spirits, cat, camel, felucca, vegetation, water, cyanotype palette and grain, layout, matte printed look. Do not add any new text or objects.
